arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
# Data from Treasury Bulletin - Calendar years, Series E and EE, interest-bearing debt
# 1994 bulletin page 69 and 1995 bulletin page 63

# Calendar year interest-bearing debt (in millions):
debt_1992 = 144724  # 1992
debt_1993 = 158633  # 1993
debt_1994 = 166731  # 1994

# BLS Annual Average CPI-U values
cpi_1992 = 140.3
cpi_1993 = 144.5
cpi_1994 = 148.2

# Adjust to constant 1994 dollars
adj_1992 = debt_1992 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1992)
adj_1993 = debt_1993 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1993)
adj_1994 = debt_1994 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1994)

print("Inflation-adjusted values (in millions, constant 1994 dollars):")
print(f"1992: {adj_1992:.2f}")
print(f"1993: {adj_1993:.2f}")
print(f"1994: {adj_1994:.2f}")

# Now calculate sample z-score for 1994 value
# Using n-1 for standard deviation (sample std dev)
values = [adj_1992, adj_1993, adj_1994]
n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n
import math
sample_variance = sum((x - mean)**2 for x in values) / (n - 1)
sample_std = math.sqrt(sample_variance)

print(f"\nMean: {mean:.2f}")
print(f"Sample Std Dev (n-1): {sample_std:.2f}")

z_score = (adj_1994 - mean) / sample_std
print(f"\nSample z-score for 1994: {z_score:.2f}")
EOF
